official.deadline_note: The notice states that applications must be submitted not later than 21 September 2026. The page still displays Status: Open as at the verification date of 10 October 2026, so the published closing date has already passed.
official.status_note: The Ghana Scholarships Authority page shows Status: Open and the notice was published on 5 September 2026, but the published deadline of 21 September 2026 has passed as at 10 October 2026, so this round should be treated as closed despite the Open label.
benefits: Scholarship awards for undergraduate studies, vocational/technical education and religious studies for the 2026/2027 academic year, tenable in Algeria
One year of French language training for all successful candidates, after which they are offered their main course of study
Free application assistance from the Ghana Scholarships Authority Secretariat, which states no individual, group or third party has been engaged to assist applicants
eligibility: Be Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana
Have completed Senior High School education with current result (i.e. year 2025)
Must have obtained an aggregate score of not more than 13
Not be more than twenty-three (23) years of age
Must have a genuine birth certificate
Master's in Islamic Studies only: a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Islamic Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law and Political Science, or Arabic Language and Literature
Religious studies (Imam training) only: good command of spoken and written Arabic and full or partial memorisation of the Holy Quran
requirements: Log in to the Ghana Scholarships Authority website www.scholarships.gov.gh
Create an account and register under the "Algerian Government Scholarship"
Complete the online application, print the application form and submit it with copies of WASSCE result slips, birth certificates and transcript to the Ghana Scholarships Authority
Master's category applicants must additionally attach copies of their degree certificates and transcripts
documents: For the Master's category: copies of the degree certificate and transcript
Printed copy of the completed online application form
coverage: University education (undergraduate studies) in Algeria for the 2026/2027 academic year
Vocational education and technical training as a two-year professional certificate
Religious studies as a three-year Imam training programme
Master's in Islamic Studies as a two-year programme
One year of French language training before the main course of study for all successful candidates
application_method: Register online at www.scholarships.gov.gh under the Algerian Government Scholarship
Submit the form with the required documents to the Director-General, Ghana Scholarships Authority, P.O. Box M.75, Accra, office at GES Council Building, Behind Accra High School, North Ridge
official.application_route: Register on www.scholarships.gov.gh under the Algerian Government Scholarship, then submit the printed form with documents to the Ghana Scholarships Authority in Accra.
official.international_eligibility: Not open internationally - restricted to Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Undergraduate: Science and Technology, Mathematics, Computer Science, Architecture, Medicine, Veterinary Sciences, Dentistry, Agricultural Sciences, Pharmacy, Urban Planning. Vocational/technical (2 years): Graphic Design Layout Artist, Senior Technician in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Industrial Maintenance, Quality Control and Processing of Dairy Products, Computer Science (database management, web and mobile application developer), Computer Systems and Networks (Cybersecurity), Automotive Mechatronics. Religious studies: 3-year Imam Training. Postgraduate: Master's in Islamic Studies (2 years).
official.duration: Undergraduate degree programme; 2 years for the vocational/technical professional certificate; 3 years for Imam training; 2 years for the Master's in Islamic Studies, preceded by one year of French language training
official.description: Applications are invited from interested and qualified candidates who wish to be considered for scholarship awards for undergraduate studies, vocational/technical education and religious studies for the 2026/2027 academic year, tenable in Algeria, under the joint Algeria/Ghana government scheme administered by the Ghana Scholarships Authority.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a paper-plus-portal application: you register on the Ghana Scholarships Authority website under the Algerian Government Scholarship, print the form, and physically submit it with your WASSCE result slips, birth certificate and transcript to the Authority in North Ridge, Accra, so an online-only submission is not enough. The gates are numeric and unforgiving - a WASSCE aggregate of 13 or better from the 2025 result and an age of 23 or below - and they are applied as published conditions rather than guidelines. Be aware that the published deadline of 21 September 2026 has already passed, so treat the Open label on the page with caution and confirm with the Authority whether a further round will be advertised. If you are admitted to the Islamic Studies or religious studies streams, build a year of French language training into your plans before your main course begins.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent Ghanaian Senior High School graduates with a 2025 WASSCE aggregate of 13 or better who want an Algerian degree, a two-year vocational qualification, or Imam training, and who can also apply for the Master's in Islamic Studies with a relevant first degree.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your WASSCE aggregate is 13 or better and that your result is from the 2025 sitting, since the notice specifies the current (2025) result
Confirm you are 23 or under at the time of application
Create your account on www.scholarships.gov.gh early, register under the Algerian Government Scholarship and complete the online form
Print the completed form and attach copies of WASSCE result slips, birth certificate and transcript, plus degree certificate and transcript if applying for the Master's category
Deliver the package to the Director-General at the GES Council Building, Behind Accra High School, North Ridge, or confirm the postal address P.O. Box M.75, Accra before the closing date
Contact the Authority at apply@scholarships.gov.gh or 0302 907 051 / 0302 907 058 to confirm whether the window has been extended
common_rejection_risks: A WASSCE aggregate worse than 13, or a result from a sitting other than 2025, both of which are published disqualifiers
Submitting the online application without the printed form and physical documents, which the notice requires
Missing a document category - for example a Master's applicant who omits the degree certificate and transcript
Applying for the religious studies stream without demonstrable Arabic and Quran memorisation, or for the Master's without a qualifying first degree in one of the four listed fields
document_audit: The birth certificate must be genuine and match the name on your WASSCE results and passport exactly; discrepancies here are the most common avoidable failure
A passport is a stated requirement, so start or renew it before the window opens rather than after
Transcripts must accompany result slips - the notice asks for both, and one without the other is an incomplete file
For the Master's stream, both the degree certificate and the transcript are required as copies
alerts: The published deadline of 21 September 2026 has already passed, yet the page still shows Status: Open; verify the current position with the Authority before preparing documents
All successful candidates must complete one year of French language training before their main course of study, so factor an extra year into your timeline and finances
The Authority warns that its services are free and that no individual, group or third party has been engaged to assist applicants, so be wary of anyone charging for help
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register online at www.scholarships.gov.gh under the Algerian Government Scholarship, complete and print the form, then submit it with the required documents to the Ghana Scholarships Authority in Accra by the published closing date.
